response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, entrepreneurial initiative with GISCollective, and deep technical versatility across languages and platforms, including AI-agent infrastructure work — but lacks clear evidence of cloud/AI platform leadership at scale, formal AI expertise, or director-level strategic impact required for this role.
strengths: Proven entrepreneurial spirit with open-source AI-adjacent platform (GISCollective)
Broad technical fluency across cloud-native tools (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK) and languages (TypeScript, DLang)
Demonstrated leadership in knowledge sharing and technical workshops
concerns: No explicit AI/ML product development or cloud platform strategy experience beyond minor agent infrastructure work
Lacks advanced degree in AI or related field; education is BS in CS only
No evidence of advising strategic customers or driving enterprise-level AI cloud roadmaps
